 Faster. Smarter. Safer. This is how Aecon Utilities is committed to delivering projects. We simply do it better. We are Ontarioâs premier utility contractor and are ready to become Canadaâs #1 utility construction provider.

Reporting to the Locates Supervisor, the Utility and Private Utility Locator will be responsible for performing utility locates for gas, electricity, telecommunications, water and sewers. Please note that this position is unionized, therefore it will be a requirement to join the union upon acceptance.

The areas of service include Ottawa and Cambridge.

What You'll Do Here

  • Safely locate underground utilities accurately using utility record systems and electronic locating equipment.
  • Field mark and document utility locates using locate work management software, and following prescribed documentation procedures.
  • Complete locate requests assigned by Foreperson/Coordinator/Superintendent accurately and in a timely manner.
  • Understand and utilize infrastructure records in planning/completing utility locates.
  • Safely operate a company provided vehicle including planning the travel to/from work sites.
  • Work (as assigned) as a member of locate project teams.
  • Communicate with Superintendent, Foreman, Coordinator and Client contacts (both internal and external to Aecon) - verbal, email, etc.
  • Perform other duties and responsibilities as assigned.

  • DPT Certification is considered a strong asset.
